about: Big boards for the Mock Draft Maker. College prospects carry espnCollegeAthleteId + collegeTeamId, matched against ESPN's Division I rosters on 2026-11-14, so stats, measurables and headshots load live. High school and international prospects have no ESPN ids; the UI shows an initials badge. 'summary' and 'comp' are archetype notes derived from position and size, not first-hand scouting. Edit freely.

2027.summary: Wing with positional size who fits as a two-way connector. Turning open threes into a reliable weapon is the key swing skill.
